column1: # Words Urdu speakers routinely write in the Urdu script but which are NOT
# phonetically derivable from the Urdu phonetic rules: English spelling says
# little about English sound, so "school" would come out سچول and "phone" پھونے.
# Typed on the Urdu phonetic layout, the English spelling on the left commits
# Kept short on purpose. A word is here only if the Urdu script is how it is
# normally written in Urdu text (اسکول, موبائل, ڈاکٹر); anything people write in
# Latin letters even mid-Urdu-sentence belongs in the English-words setting
# Format: spelling<TAB>urdu   (one mapping per line; # starts a comment)
